item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Katy Perry & Kylie Minogue Videos
item.description:
Hi everyone! I’m looking for some missing Kylie Minogue and Katy Perry music videos for my personal collection. I’m specifically looking for native 1080p HDTV / WEB quality, without AI upscale, fan upscale, or remastering. Sources such as Apple Music, TIDAL, Vevo, HDTV broadcasts, or other official/native sources are very welcome.
Kylie Minogue
  • All I See
  • Wow
  • Better Than Today
  • In My Arms
I’m especially interested in better/larger-quality versions of Wow, Better Than Today and In My Arms, as the versions I currently have are relatively small and I’m looking for a higher-quality native source.

Katy Perry
  • Hot N Cold
  • Waking Up in Vegas
  • Feels (Version 2)
  • Tucked (The Smile Video Series)
  • Resilient (The Smile Video Series)
  • What Makes a Woman (The Smile Video Series)
  • Harleys in Hawaii (The Smile Video Series)
  • Never Really Over (The Smile Video Series)
  • Teary Eyes (Behind the Smile)
  • Electric
  • Lifetimes
  • Woman’s World
  • Who You Love
  • Thinking of You
  • Thinking of You (Extended Version)
  • Thinking of You (Original Version)
  • The Box
  • Simple
  • Long Shot
For Thinking of You (Original Version), The Box, Simple and Long Shoot, I know they may not be available on the usual platforms, but I would really appreciate any good-quality native source if someone has one. I’m not looking for upscales or fan-made remasters, native resolution/source is much more important to me, even if the original resolution is lower than 1080p.
If anyone has any of these in good quality and would be willing to share, I would really appreciate it. <3
Thank you so much!
